description: Run one to eight deterministic first-order stress scenarios against verified portfolio delta. Nonlinear positions require explicit P&L adjustments; incomplete risk remains unavailable. Never signs, funds, bridges, or trades.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

asset_shocks_pct.description: Canonical asset symbols mapped to bounded percentage changes.

nonlinear_pnl_adjustments_usd.description: Owned nonlinear position IDs mapped to explicit additive scenario P&L in USD.
